name: Order-block retest in the day direction on a straight path
why: The day direction (09:50 cascade or gap side) is institutional repositioning that continues; on a straight path a pullback into the last unmitigated order block is where late buyers (sellers) of that move get filled and the trapped faders cover. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_smc_path_direction.md).

stop: max(0.1*atr, 0.25 + max((((abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr)*sign(at(9,50)-open) + (1-(abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr))*(!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap)) > 0)*(px - obl(5,n,m)), (((abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr)*sign(at(9,50)-open) + (1-(abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr))*(!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap)) < 0)*(obhs(5,n,m) - px)))
